name: matrixkoder
description: Orchestrate multi-phase builds across Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and AGY in herdr worktree lanes, with usage-aware routing, durable run state and an in-session dashboard.

guards.title: Guards
guards.description: Deny destructive git and project-banned commands

autoOpen.title: Auto-open pane
autoOpen.description: Open the dashboard pane when a session starts

chip.title: Status chip
chip.description: Pin the run health chip under the prompt

wake.title: Wake on events
wake.description: Submit prompt when lanes encounter verifying, blocked, quota, stalled or provider

stopGuard.title: Stop guard
stopGuard.description: Block a stop once per set of RED/REWORK/DUE rows in an orchestrator checkout of a fidelity run (never in a lane or solo)

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Solo runs no orchestration: no lane sweep, build in this session

defaultTab.title: Default tab
defaultTab.description: The dashboard tab the pane opens on

hiddenTabs.title: Hidden tabs
hiddenTabs.description: Comma-separated dashboard tabs to hide (Settings is never hidden)

raster.title: Raster bars
raster.description: Draw Raster bars; off uses the eighth-block fallback
